title: Research audit: exact fixed-source packed-bit repair law (no new kappa)
body:
## Result and scope

This mathematical audit derives the exact repair density of the retained eight-rotation packed-bit gadget on each fixed-source fiber. With B=2^K and consecutive positions j_t of the used source 1 bits,

`d(c) = 1 - product_t(1 - 2/B^(j_(t+1)-j_t))`.

The written proof covers every K>=6, f>=1 and allowed offset, with complete y,z fields. It also gives sharp extrema at fixed source weight and recovers PR773's complete-rectangle average. At K=6,f=3, source x=65 has density 1/32 versus the average 1/128. Source patterns 110 and 101 have equal weight but different exact densities. No new kappa is claimed.

This extends Precious (@Kyu)'s PR773 (`dbd9da3eed9a0045b77de861099e869259f1ad13`) and credits Aryan Sudhir's PR735 (`8d36139e49add1e55795e283b3bfa45e1cfe1bf0`). PR773 explicitly excludes a per-source guarantee; PR735 counts a sufficient guard envelope. The new evidence is the actual source-pattern law, including cancellation across zero-source segments, its sharp extrema and the conditional-count audit. Neither predecessor theorem is contradicted.

## Review and verification

Only `research/packed-source-fibers-seed62/` is added. Start with its README proof, SOURCES.json and EXPECTED.json. Base: `49b3157d1d89adcef16df8be98445451672be5ba`; upstream manuscript pin: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`. Track: adversarial mathematical audit; OS-random seed 62. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1233).

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/packed-source-fibers-seed62
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

Local CPython 3.12.13 and 3.14.6 checks pass: 873,760 digit cases, 8,188 source patterns, 541,200 complete small-fiber states, 49,792 source-domain simulator comparisons, and exact sorted-payload repair. The optimized relocated replay rejects four mathematical mutations and four packaging faults. Package metadata/pins, all four retained finite-identity tests and `make selected-record-check` pass. Hosted CI is separate.

The quantified claim rests on the written proof; finite replay is corroboration. A source-restricted physical caller would still need to admit its layout and pay the complete movement/repair bill. All-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain outside scope. The selected supplier cold replay was not run for this isolated addition.

Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; predecessor credit is retained in the package.
